FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 214
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/31/2023
Senate Bill 214 as passed the Senate could prohibit the use of certain state software systems that
would conflict with the definition of "centralized motor vehicle registration", as provided by this
bill. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
